data.title: Stripe Bets Over $8 Billion On OpenRouter's AI Model Traffic
data.description: Stripe has agreed to buy OpenRouter for more than $8 billion, buying distribution and inference demand rather than metering tech. The neutrality question comes with it.
data.author: Janakiram MSV
data.keywords: Stripe OpenRouter acquisition,AI gateway,model routing,AI infrastructure M&A,inference spend,usage-based billing,Metronome,Tempo,enterprise AI cost,agentic commerce
